name: 裴珀·叠牌
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:530
who: Pepper Foldcard, a halfling street conjurer from the lower town, twenty years old in this year: about 108 cm, small and light, quick on her feet, with legs strong enough to carry a trunk taller than herself all day. Honey-gold curly hair tied in two bunches, and a small butterfly folded from a playing card pinned at the end of each. A round face, a dusting of freckles across the bridge of the nose, and very large bright teal-green eyes like two glass beads that miss nothing. No earrings, no glasses. A nimble, chattering, warm-hearted trickster air. She always notices where the light falls and whose sleeve is hiding something.
build: 108 cm, small and light, a small round frame.
palette: card red and white, honey gold, teal green, faded linen, a little black
casual: Her road clothes: a short red-and-white diamond-check cape fastened at the throat. Under it a washed-out linen shirt with the sleeves rolled once, braces over knee-length dark brown shorts, red-and-white striped knee stockings that leave no leg bare, and soft laced shoes. Three decks of cards hang at her belt in small leather pouches, and one deck is still in its unbroken paper seal. On her back is a tall painted wooden card trunk, taller than she is, carried on two straps. She fans a hand of cards in one hand with a quick closed-mouth grin.
private: Off stage at a lodging: the cape is off. She wears a loose long-sleeved linen shirt, long brown wool trousers and a knitted waistcoat buttoned up, and the two card butterflies are still pinned at the ends of her bunches. She stands squaring a deck of cards in both hands, quiet for once, the brows slightly drawn.
battle: Ready for a trick that can kill, in a few salvaged pieces over her road clothes: the diamond-check cape is thrown back off the shoulders. Over the linen shirt a snug brown vest of old enchanted leather from the wall stores, a thin rune line glowing blue-white along its seams; on both wrists salvaged steel bracers with brass hinges and one small lit crystal each, playing cards slotted inside; the shorts with the striped stockings, and soft shoes for climbing rooftops. The trunk is left behind. A spray of playing cards fans out from her right hand, a few already spinning in the air, and her left hand is held open and empty, palm out. Sharp bright eyes and a closed-mouth smirk.
formal: Hired to perform at the upper-city spring banquet: a fitted red-and-white diamond-check doublet with a small white ruff collar and long sleeves ending in white lace cuffs, dark knee breeches over white stockings, buckled black shoes, and a little black felt cap with one white feather. The card butterflies are freshly folded. A white dove perches on her raised left hand while her right hand rests on her chest in a showman's bow.
art: A tilted close portrait with the face large. Her teal-green eyes glance sideways at the viewer over a fan of cards held near her cheek, with a sly closed-mouth smile. Warm lantern-gold light comes from one side and cool white-stone light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting playing cards, folded paper butterflies, a single white feather and a wisp of grey smoke.
battle_old: Ready for a trick that can kill: the diamond-check cape is thrown back off the shoulders. She wears a snug brown leather vest buckled over the linen shirt, leather bracers at the wrists with cards slotted inside, the shorts with the striped stockings, and soft shoes for climbing rooftops. The trunk is left behind. A spray of playing cards fans out from her right hand, a few already spinning in the air, and her left hand is held open and empty, palm out. Sharp bright eyes and a closed-mouth smirk.
gear: 共鸣｜贫｜照常｜1档｜底座写共鸣 LVL 38。她是下街散了班的篷车戏法人，家境穷，又要轻身上房，只在干活的衣服外头加两三件捡来的附魔件。

name: 梅岱娜·埃尔斯纳
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:1230
who: Medaena Elsner, a human well-finder from the southern outer valley, nineteen in 624: about 170 cm, tall and sturdy, with shoulders and forearms built by hauling water and long slender fingers. Her pale wheat-gold hair is cut straight at the chin so it never hangs into a well mouth. Deep green eyes like her father's. A faint pale scar runs across the bridge of her nose, left by a bucket rim in childhood. She carries an old wooden bucket on her back and a short pick behind her waist. No jewellery. A plain, direct, steady air. When she listens for water she tilts her head and shuts one eye.
build: 170 cm, tall and sturdy: flat strong shoulders and back, firm forearms, a C-cup, a trim waist and full hips.
palette: washed-out cornflower blue, wheat gold, deep green, old oak brown, a little iron
casual: Her well-finding clothes: a washed-out blue short tunic cut down from her father's old one, belted, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, with sturdy undyed linen trousers tucked into worn leather boots wrapped with cord. An old wooden bucket hooped three times hangs upside down on her back, its rope knotted across her chest in a slipknot and its base scored with seven scratch marks. Her father's spare short pick is thrust crosswise through the belt behind her waist. She stands with her head tilted and one eye closed, listening, one finger raised.
private: Resting after a day at the wells: a long-sleeved undyed linen dress to the shins with a faded blue knitted shawl around the shoulders and soft leather shoes. She holds a coil of bucket rope in both hands, untying and retying the slipknot, with a small quiet smile.
battle: Ready for the dry riverbeds and what crawls in them, in salvaged pieces over her well-finding clothes: a worn grey wall-issue enchanted leather jerkin laced over the blue tunic, a faint blue-white rune line along its edge; one dented enchanted pauldron re-strapped with well rope on the left shoulder, a single small crystal still lit in its socket; brass-jointed forearm guards from a broken war machine; a wide belt with a water skin and a small rune lantern, the trousers tucked into her boots. The bucket stays on her back on its rope. She holds the short pick low in her right hand, a faint white line of light along its iron head, and her left hand is open toward the ground as if feeling it. A level, focused look.
formal: Her best clothes for a village water-sharing feast: a clean deep blue wool coat buttoned to the collar, a long undyed linen skirt and polished boots, with a sprig of reeds pinned at the breast and her hair combed smooth. She stands straight-backed with her hands clasped in front and a shy look.
art: A tilted portrait with one ear turned toward the ground as she listens. One deep green eye is shut and the other looks at the viewer, and her lips move as if counting. Cool blue water light rises from below on one side. Foreground blur: drops of spring water, the rim of the old bucket and a few reed tips.
battle_old: Ready for the dry riverbeds and what crawls in them: a worn leather jerkin laced over the blue tunic, leather bracers, and a wide belt with a water skin, the trousers tucked into her boots. The bucket stays on her back on its rope. She holds the short pick low in her right hand, a faint white line of light along its iron head, and her left hand is open toward the ground as if feeling it. A level, focused look.
gear: 共鸣｜贫｜照常｜1档｜底座写共鸣 LVL 24。她是谷外打井人家的姑娘，替买不起渠水的村子找水，穿的是捡来拼上的附魔件。旧桶和短镐不动。

name: 塞巴德·埃尔斯纳
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3587
who: Sebald Elsner, a human well-digger of the outer valley. He was thirty-two when his name took hold in 612 and looked exactly that age ever after. About 184 cm, broad-shouldered and narrow-waisted, with long ropy muscles in the arms from swinging a pick. Short wheat-brown hair always dusted with stone grit and deep green eyes. The outer end of his left eyebrow is broken off short (on the viewer's right when he faces us). The valley sun has reddened his neck, which stays pale below the collar. When he smiles, one side of his upper lip lifts first. No jewellery. A patient, practical, warm air.
build: 184 cm, broad shoulders and a narrow waist, lean arms corded from swinging a pick.
palette: faded indigo blue, wheat brown, deep green, stone white, dark iron
casual: His working clothes: a much-washed, faded blue short tunic with the collar open and the sleeves pushed up, a leather belt with a pouch of iron wedges, coarse brown trousers patched at the knees and scuffed hobnailed boots. He carries a long well-digger's pick on his right shoulder and stands loose and easy, about to set off somewhere, with a lopsided smile.
private: At home in the valley: the new undyed linen shirt the seven villages gave him, sleeves rolled up, and brown trousers already holed at both knees, with soft old shoes. He holds a length of bucket rope, tying a slipknot to show someone how it is done, with a patient smile.
battle: Going down a well, in a digger's kit pieced from war salvage rather than a soldier's harness: a heavy oilcloth apron over the blue tunic with a salvaged grey enchanted breastplate strapped over it, a faint blue-white rune line along its edge; a rope harness at the waist hooked with brass clips cut from a clockwork war machine; leather wrist wraps under brass-jointed forearm plates etched with a dim rune circuit; a stub of candle in a tin holder hooked at his belt. He grips the long pick in both hands across his body, a thin white line of light running along its iron head. A calm, set face.
battle_pose: 3) the digging outfit: braced and steady, the feet planted wide, the shoulders squared, gripping the long pick in both hands ready to strike stone; he is a well-digger, not a soldier.
formal: Guest at the water-sharing feast held in his honour: the new linen shirt buttoned to the collar under a deep blue wool waistcoat and a clean brown coat, with a sprig of willow pinned at the chest and brushed boots. He stands a little awkwardly with his hands behind his back and the lopsided smile.
art: A tilted portrait with his cheek pressed against rough stone as he listens. His deep green eyes turn to the viewer as the lopsided smile begins. Cold white light pours through cracks in the stone on one side, and warm candlelight falls on the other. Foreground blur: falling grit and stone chips and a spray of dark water droplets.
battle_old: Going down a well: a heavy oilcloth apron over the blue tunic, a rope harness at the waist, leather wrist wraps, and a stub of candle in a tin holder hooked at his belt. He grips the long pick in both hands across his body, a thin white line of light running along its iron head. A calm, set face.
gear: 灵格｜贫｜照常（打井人，不是兵）｜1档｜原页只给 AI 的那一层写明他是灵格的凡人，家境是山边村子的打井人，穷。姿势句说他不是兵，所以只把下井的家什换成捡来的附魔件，蜡烛头和长镐不动。

name: 芭鲁娜
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3587
who: Baruna, a demon of the forge-hell clan from the Dorkan camp across the stork bridge. She gives her camp's name and never a family name. She was thirty-six when her name took hold in 626 but still looks to be in her twenties. About 191 cm, tall and heavily built. Deep bronze skin, as her clan has, and red-tinged black hair braided flat to the head in short tight braids. Amber eyes and short, hard, dark red horns sweeping back. Both palms have been burnt black since the bridge, while the backs of her hands are unmarked. No jewellery. A gentle, careful giant who keeps telling people to slow down.
build: 191 cm, tall and powerfully built: thick shoulders and back, solid legs, a C-cup, a firm waist and broad hips.
palette: deep bronze, ember red, soot black, amber, ash white
casual: Her escort's clothes: a worn dark leather jerkin over a coarse rust-red shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a heavy leather work apron, and wide dark trousers tucked into hobnailed boots. An iron camp tag stamped with the Dorkan mark hangs on a cord at her throat. She holds a small wooden toy horse whose legs are uneven, a little slope board nailed under its hooves, turning it over in her blackened palms with a shy smile.
private: Off duty in the camp: a loose long-sleeved undyed wool tunic and a rust-red wrap skirt over leggings, with soft hide boots. She cradles a white clay bowl in both black palms, steam rising from it, with a sleepy, contented look.
battle: Ready to carry what no one else can, in salvaged war plate over her work clothes: two heavy grey enchanted pauldrons from a wall armoury riveted onto the dark leather jerkin, rune lines glowing faint blue-white along their rims; both forearms wrapped thick and cased in brass-jointed plates salvaged from a clockwork war machine, stopping short of the bare palms; a broad belt cinched tight, the apron, hobnailed boots, the iron camp tag at her throat. She carries no weapon. Both burnt-black hands are raised palm up at shoulder height as if bracing a stone beam, legs braced, with a calm, intent face and the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced like a pillar, the feet wide and planted, both black palms raised at shoulder height as if holding up a great weight; she carries no weapon.
formal: At the prisoner-exchange ceremony: a clean long dark red wool coat buttoned to the throat, a short black cloak, black trousers and polished boots, with the iron camp tag worn outside the collar. She stands straight with her black palms hidden in her sleeves, the tips of her ears faintly red.
art: A tilted portrait with her face lit from below by white fire. Both black palms are lifted near the edge of the frame as if bearing something enormous, and her amber eyes rest on the viewer, steady and kind. Hot white-orange light comes from below and cool dusk blue from above. Foreground blur: sparks, flakes of cracked glazed stone and a thread of smoke.
battle_old: Ready to carry what no one else can: heavy leather shoulder guards over the jerkin, thick wrapped forearms, a broad belt cinched tight, the apron and boots. She carries no weapon. Both burnt-black hands are raised palm up at shoulder height as if bracing a stone beam, legs braced, with a calm, intent face and the mouth closed.
gear: 灵格（估）｜贫｜不靠兵器｜1档｜凝名的人照塞巴德那一档，估灵格。她出身营里，不报家姓，家境穷。她只拿身子扛东西，不拿兵器，所以只加捡来的肩甲和臂甲，两只烧黑的掌心照旧露着。

name: 朵娜·芦沟
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3587
who: Dona Reedditch, a human spearwoman of the lower weir village. She was forty-eight when her name took hold in 633 and has looked that age ever since. About 173 cm, solid in the shoulders and back. Long deep red hair streaked with early white, tied at the nape. Bright honey-coloured eyes and faint lines across the forehead. An old debt-brand sits on the back of her neck, under the hair. The shoulder seams of her coat are let out wide for lifting a spear, and the cuffs are mended with especially fine stitches. No jewellery. A brisk, warm, stubborn air; her word is always 'again'.
face: FACE, as in the references: a woman of forty-eight, NOT a young face: bright honey-coloured eyes with fine crow's feet at the outer corners, faint horizontal lines across the forehead, soft lines beside the mouth, thick straight dark red eyebrows, a firm mouth that smiles at one corner, a strong chin; a few white strands at the temples. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 173 cm, sturdy: strong shoulders and back, a B-cup, a solid waist and full hips.
palette: deep red, honey gold, reed green, washed linen, dark iron
casual: Her everyday village clothes: a dark green-brown wool coat with the shoulder seams let out wide and finely mended cuffs, over a washed coarse linen dress to the shins, with an apron and worn boots. She carries a basket of greens with a wrapped fish on one arm, wearing a frown that is nearly a smile.
private: At home after supper: a long-sleeved faded red wool dress with a knitted shawl and soft shoes, her white-streaked hair loose down her back. She holds a little cloth-wrapped wooden practice spear she carved for her granddaughter, inspecting it with the brows drawn.
battle: Holding the narrow stone neck, in old weir-garrison war gear pieced together and refitted: over the wide-seamed coat a grey wall-issue enchanted half-cuirass re-laced with leather thongs, a blue-white rune line glowing along its edge and one magic crystal lit at the breastbone; a single scuffed enchanted pauldron on the spear shoulder; a mended rune-etched steel bracer on each forearm; the coat skirt tucked into the belt, and heavy boots. She holds the plain old weir spear she picked up in 607, its grip wrapped in faded cloth, tucked tight under her arm and aimed forward, a thin white light glinting at the point. Feet planted, a hard, focused look.
formal: On a feast day at the lower weir: a clean deep blue wool coat buttoned to the collar, a long dark skirt, a white linen kerchief at the throat and polished boots, her hair neatly tied. She stands with her hands folded, straight-backed and a little stiff.
art: A tilted portrait with the spear shaft running diagonally past her face. Her honey eyes are fixed on the viewer, set and unafraid, with a few white strands loose across the forehead. Hard white light runs along the spear from one side and cold night blue fills the other. Foreground blur: stone dust, reed tips and a fleck of white light.
battle_old: Holding the narrow stone neck: old wall-issue leather armour over the wide-seamed coat, a mended leather bracer on each forearm, the coat skirt tucked into the belt, and heavy boots. She holds the plain old weir spear she picked up in 607, its grip wrapped in faded cloth, tucked tight under her arm and aimed forward, a thin white light glinting at the point. Feet planted, a hard, focused look.
gear: 灵格（估）｜贫｜照常｜2档｜凝名的堰口枪手，估灵格。她出身下堰的村子，脖后有债印，家境穷。她是守石颈的兵，身上是堰口发的旧附魔墙甲，拼凑起来改合身。607年捡的那杆旧枪不换。

name: 涅妮娅
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3661
who: Nenia, a Whitebone demon and priestess before the throne of the Lord of Grave-Candles and Withered Bone. Born around 380, she looks a little over thirty: tall and thin, standing perfectly still. Ash-white long hair in one braid with a small bone bell tied at its end. A thin line of crystal-clear white bone shows through the skin along the left side of her jaw up to the ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us). Very pale cyan eyes and pale skin. A black veil falls from her head to her ankles. She carries a stone grave-lamp burning with a cold blue-green flame. Apart from the bell, no jewellery. A soft-voiced, devout, implacable air.
palette: veil black, ash white, cold blue-green, bone ivory, slate
casual: Her priestly dress: a long, high-collared black gown that closes down the front with small bone buttons and has fitted sleeves, under a sheer black veil falling from the crown of the head to the ankles, with soft black boots. In her right hand she holds a heavy carved stone lamp on a short chain, with a pierced stone shade and a cold blue-green flame inside. She stands perfectly upright and still, her other hand open at her side.
private: Waiting between feasts: the veil folded back off her head onto her shoulders, a plain ash-grey long gown with fitted sleeves and soft slippers. She holds a slim bound ledger of names against her chest, reading with lowered eyes.
battle: Calling the dead, in the vestments of her throne rather than armour: her black veil, its hem stitched with grave-runes in thread that glows faint blue-green, is swept back by a cold wind over the high-collared black gown, whose small bone buttons are each carved with a warding sign and lit pale; a close gorget of thin bone-silver plates at the collar; the bone bell swings at the end of her braid. She raises the stone lamp high in her right hand and lifts its pierced shade away with her left, the blue-green flame flaring upward. No weapon. A serene, unpitying face.
battle_pose: 3) the rite outfit: perfectly upright, lifting the stone lamp high in one hand and raising its shade with the other, the cold flame flaring; she carries no blade and does not fight with her hands.
formal: At the century feast before the throne: a long gown of layered black gauze over black silk, a high collar edged with tiny bone beads and long fitted sleeves, with the black veil held by a narrow band of carved bone across the brow. She holds the stone lamp before her in both hands, standing still and solemn.
art: A tilted portrait with half her face lit from below by the stone lamp's cold blue-green flame. Her pale cyan eyes rest on the viewer, calm as a prayer, and the crystal line of bone along her jaw catches the light. Foreground blur: drifting ash, a small bone bell and the edge of the black veil.
battle_old: Calling the dead: her black veil is swept back by a cold wind over the high-collared black gown, and the bone bell swings at the end of her braid. She raises the stone lamp high in her right hand and lifts its pierced shade away with her left, the blue-green flame flaring upward. No weapon. A serene, unpitying face.
gear: 极境（估）｜世家｜法袍｜4档｜她是坟原那一座黑山的座前祭司，活了近三百年，估极境，身份贵重。姿势句写明她不用刀、不动手，所以照她的档用好东西，只落在法衣上：发光的坟符纹和骨银护颈，不穿甲。石灯不动。

name: 迪波尔德
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3679
who: Dipold, a human priest of the cathedral's old faction, an orphan raised in a monastery on the southern wall. He keeps the prayers of the nine white-stone arches of the upper city and is fifty-eight in 598. Middle height with a slightly stooped back. Thin white hair cut short, bushy white eyebrows, and very pale blue eyes that always look faintly apologetic. In his right hand he holds an ash-wood prayer staff, its head set with nine fingernail-sized white stones arranged in an arch. No glasses, no rings. A mild, kindly, utterly convinced air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man of fifty-eight: very pale blue eyes with drooping outer corners and deep crow's feet, bushy white eyebrows drawn slightly together in a gentle, apologetic look, a lined forehead, hollowed cheeks, a clean-shaven chin, thin lips with a soft smile. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
palette: white stone, pale ash wood, soft grey, pale blue, a little old gold
casual: His daily priestly dress: a long white wool robe washed to a soft grey-white that closes down the front with buttons and has fitted sleeves, a plain grey stole with a small arch of nine white stitches at each end, a rope belt and simple leather shoes. He leans slightly on the ash-wood staff in his right hand with a mild, patient expression.
private: Evening at the old-faction sanctuary: a plain grey wool long gown with fitted sleeves, a knitted shawl and soft slippers. He holds the staff loosely in one hand and a small clay cup of tea in the other, with a tired, kindly look.
battle: Calling the Nine Gates, in the cathedral's warding vestments: the white robe woven of heavier enchanted wool, its hem and cuffs edged with a faint white rune line; small white-stone ward plaques sewn at both shoulders, each lit like a candle; the grey stole fluttering, the nine white stitches at its ends glowing in an arch; a rope belt hung with little white-stone charms. He raises the staff high over his head in his right hand, all nine white stones blazing like noon, and holds his left hand open as if blessing. His mouth is open in a shout and his pale eyes are wide.
formal: Leading the spring rite of the arches: a white robe under a broad white silk overvestment hemmed in old gold thread with a row of nine small arches, and a white cap. He holds the staff upright before him in both hands and, for once, stands fully straight.
art: A tilted portrait with the staff head and its nine white stones close to his face, the last stone cracking open with light. His pale blue eyes are on the viewer, sorrowful and certain. Brilliant white light falls from above on one side and deep night blue fills the other. Foreground blur: white stone chips, flakes of light and a curl of smoke.
battle_old: Calling the Nine Gates: the white robe, the grey stole fluttering. He raises the staff high over his head in his right hand, all nine white stones blazing like noon, and holds his left hand open as if blessing. His mouth is open in a shout and his pale eyes are wide.
gear: 灵格（估）｜富｜法袍｜3档｜他是上城大教堂旧派的老祭司，管九道门的祷文，有教堂供着，家境算富。他是修士，不穿甲，所以档落在祭衣上：附魔羊毛袍、发光的九针圣带、白石护符。祷杖不动。

name: 贡多尔夫·赖歇瑙
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3768
who: Gondolf Reichenau, a human segment-keeper of a wall city on the southern stretch, from a soldier family and trained as an artillery calculator. Fifty-four in 651: short, with a back as straight as a gun carriage. Russet short hair gone white at the temples. His left eye is a red crystal, fitted after a crystal casing burst in his youth, and it glows faintly (on the viewer's right when he faces us); his right eye is slate blue. A brass range ruler hangs at his belt. No other jewellery. A clipped, exact, unbending air; he talks in distances and numbers.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man of fifty-four: the left eye a smooth faceted red crystal with a faint inner glow, the right eye slate blue and narrowed, deep crow's feet, a lined forehead, stern straight brows, clean-shaven, a thin hard mouth and a square jaw; the temples white. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
palette: faded gunner's grey-brown, crystal red, brass, russet, white
casual: His daily wall dress: an old grey-brown wool gunner's coat buttoned to the collar, the cuffs stained dark red with crystal powder, a broad leather belt with the brass range ruler hanging from it, and grey trousers tucked into polished black boots. He stands ramrod straight with a cold, measuring look.
private: At home in the soldiers' village: a plain undyed linen shirt buttoned to the throat, a grey wool waistcoat, brown trousers and house shoes. He holds an old cloth-bound gun ledger open in one hand, reading the gunners' names alone.
battle: Commanding from the wall, in the segment-keeper's fitted war harness: a short coat of fine enchanted mail glowing faint blue-white at the links under the old grey-brown gunner's coat; a fitted steel gorget and shoulder plates engraved only with his segment's number, no ornament; steel gauntlets with small crystal sockets stained dark red with crystal powder, one lit; the segment-keeper's seal on a chain round his neck, and polished black boots. He draws a plain straight arming sword with his right hand, NOT a curved sword, while his left hand holds the brass range ruler up beside the red crystal eye to sight the distance. A hard face.
formal: Before the southern line command: a clean grey-brown dress coat with brass buttons and a dark red collar band, a shoulder cord, white gloves, the seal on its chain, and boots polished like mirrors. He stands at attention.
art: A tilted portrait with the red crystal eye glowing in the dusk and the brass ruler held up beside it, his face stern. Low red-gold sunset light comes from one side and cold dark blue fills the other. Foreground blur: drifting red crystal powder, salt grains and the iron rim of a gun muzzle.
battle_old: Commanding from the wall: a short coat of old mail under the grey-brown gunner's coat, a leather gorget, gauntlets, the segment-keeper's seal on a chain round his neck, and black boots. He draws a plain straight arming sword with his right hand, NOT a curved sword, while his left hand holds the brass range ruler up beside the red crystal eye to sight the distance. A hard face.
gear: 极境（估）｜世家｜照常（不加装饰）｜4档｜他是段城的段守，出身兵户世家，估极境。极境加家境一档，定在4，是量身打的段守战装。他人板正，只讲数，所以甲上只刻段号，不加装饰。直剑和铜尺不动。

name: 唱歌的
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3787
who: The Singer of a band of six who never give their names (only the AI knows his: Iskan Duskrain), a tiefling descended from the grey banner of the southern marshes. He is fifty-nine in 649 and looks about forty: tall and lean. Madder-red hair in a single braid down to the waist, with a length of bright multicoloured thread woven into it, every colour a recovered piece of a song. Dark horns curve back from his temples. Pale lavender-ash skin and warm gold eyes. No jewellery. A wry, joking, bright air; he opens every show by asking who is sitting in the audience.
palette: madder red, lavender ash, warm gold, faded canvas, many-coloured thread
casual: A travelling player's clothes: a worn leather vest over a faded canvas coat with the sleeves turned back, a long multicoloured scarf, a coil of rope and a small brass bell at his belt, dark trousers and scuffed boots. He holds a battered felt hat in one hand, sweeping it out as if greeting a crowd, and grins.
private: Resting by the wagon: an untucked loose linen shirt with the collar open, a patched knitted cardigan, rolled-up trousers and old shoes. He holds a tin cup in one hand and with the other threads a new piece of coloured thread into his braid, looking amused.
battle: Singing on the march: the canvas coat buttoned and belted over the leather vest, a dark short cloak thrown back, and boots. He carries no weapon. One hand is raised high and open, a warm flame-coloured light gathering in the palm, and the other rests on his chest. His mouth is open in song and his braid swings.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: the head thrown back in song, one hand raised and open with light gathering in the palm, the feet planted; he carries no weapon.
formal: Stage dress for a lord's hall: a long deep red coat with tarnished gold frogging, a high white collar, dark breeches and tall boots, the braid hanging down his back. He makes a showman's bow with the felt hat held over his heart.
art: A tilted portrait mid-song, his gold eyes laughing at the viewer and the braid with its coloured threads swinging across the frame. Warm firelight comes from below on one side and deep violet dusk fills the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks, loose coloured threads and the edge of a wagon lantern.
face: His skin is pale lavender-ash over the whole face, neck and hands, clearly non-human tiefling colouring, NOT normal human skin tone.

name: 拿剑的
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3787
who: The Sword of a band of six who never give their names (only the AI knows his: Linhart Sten), a human of the Sten soldier family, who have mended the middle stretch of the long wall for generations. Thirty-four in 649: tall and lean, with a wall-builder's hands. Short flax-blond hair and steel blue eyes. A scar from a falling stone cuts through his left eyebrow (on the viewer's right when he faces us). The core of an old god-killing shell is set into the crossguard of his sword, and when the blade is drawn a white fire runs along it. No jewellery. Quiet, plain and steady; he speaks as if counting battlements.
palette: wall grey-brown, flax blond, steel blue, white fire, old iron
casual: Wall-family clothes: a grey-brown wool garrison coat over an old mail shirt, a mason's leather apron folded up and tucked into the belt, grey trousers and patched boots, with the sword sheathed at his left hip and a dull pale core set in its crossguard. He stands relaxed with one thumb hooked in his belt and a faint, tired smile.
private: Off the wall: a plain undyed linen shirt with rolled sleeves, a dark wool waistcoat, brown trousers and old boots. He holds a mason's trowel in one hand and a chunk of white stone in the other, turning it over.
battle: On the road to the hall, in the Sten family's handed-down war harness: a fitted breastplate and tassets of old enchanted wall steel over glowing fine mail, the plates engraved with the Sten stone-course pattern whose grooves shine soft white, matching steel pauldrons and vambraces, a faded grey-brown surcoat cut short over it; a round enchanted shield on his back whose painted stone-course crest lights up along its lines. He holds the straight longsword drawn in both hands, NOT a curved sword, with white fire running along the blade from the pale god-killer core set in the crossguard. A calm, grim face.
formal: At a wall family's feast: a clean deep blue coat buttoned to the collar, a grey sash with the Sten crest stitched small at the chest, dark trousers and polished boots. He stands with his hands clasped behind his back.
art: A tilted portrait with the drawn blade rising past his face. The white fire on the steel lights his scarred brow and his steel blue eyes, which hold steady on the viewer. Cold white light comes from the blade side against a dark slate dusk. Foreground blur: stone grit, white embers and the tip of a carved deer antler.
battle_old: On the road to the hall: the old mail shirt under a faded grey-brown surcoat, a round shield painted with the Sten family's stone-course crest slung on his back, leather bracers and boots. He holds the straight longsword drawn in both hands, NOT a curved sword, with white fire running along the blade from the pale core in the crossguard. A calm, grim face.
gear: 英雄｜中｜照常｜4档｜宴火六人在649年以前都是英雄里最高的一截，英雄不看家境，定在4。用的是斯滕家传下来的整套墙甲，配会亮的家纹盾，跟样张对得上，照样张交回。

name: 刻字的
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3787
who: The Carver of a band of six who never give their names (only the AI knows hers: Brodja Deepwell), a dwarf woman of the Deepwell line of the forge-city. She is about one hundred and forty-four in 649 and looks like a human woman of forty: short and sturdy, with a grown woman's face. Copper-red hair in two thick braids and warm hazel eyes. Soot on the fingertips. She carries a chisel and a small forge-lamp whose fire was taken from the king's forge. No jewellery. A slow, patient, steady-handed air; every third word she says is about the fire.
face: FACE, as in the references: a grown woman's face of about forty, NOT a child's: warm hazel eyes with fine lines at the corners, thick straight copper-red brows, a broad nose, cheeks rosy from forge heat, a firm mouth with a calm half-smile. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.  She is a mature dwarf woman of about forty, clearly middle-aged like someone's mother: visible crow's feet and smile lines, a fuller, weathered adult face; NOT a girl, NOT a teenager, NOT a smooth young face.
build: about 130 cm, short and sturdy: broad shoulders, strong arms, a solid compact grown woman's figure.
palette: copper red, forge orange, soot black, leather brown, steel
casual: A travelling carver's clothes: a thick brown leather work coat with many pockets and the sleeves rolled to the forearm, a heavy leather apron, a canvas shirt and dark trousers tucked into steel-toed boots. She holds a chisel in her right hand and a small iron forge-lamp with a steady orange flame in her left, standing squarely and studying something with narrowed eyes.
private: Resting by a forge: a loose rust-coloured wool shirt with rolled sleeves, braces, dark trousers and soft boots, the braids looped up. She holds a whetstone in one hand and a tin cup in the other, looking contented.
battle: Carving a forge into the walls: a leather jerkin with iron studs over the canvas shirt, a heavy apron, thick gloves and boots. She holds the forge-lamp up in her left hand and a long iron chisel raised in her right as if about to strike, with lines of lettering glowing with trapped fire around her hands. A still, intent face.
formal: Forge-city dress: a long dark brown wool coat with copper buttons that closes down the front, a high collar, a belt embroidered in copper thread, and a dark skirt to the boots, her braids bound with copper rings. She holds the lamp before her in both hands.
art: A tilted portrait with her face lit from below by the small forge-lamp, her hazel eyes calm on the viewer. Warm orange comes from the lamp side against deep iron blue behind. Foreground blur: glowing carved letters, sparks and flakes of stone.

name: 射箭的
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3787
who: The Archer of a band of six who never give their names (only the AI knows hers: Tishawen), an elf of the Verdant Crown watchers. She was born on an arrow tower during the long war and has always looked twenty-five or twenty-six: tall and slender, with long pointed ears. Long silver-cyan hair tied at the back of the head and pale violet eyes. A deer antler from her birth year is bound to the upper tip of her longbow, carved with the names of the Sten men who held the gap that year. No jewellery. A calm, precise, quietly playful air; she starts her sentences with a year.
palette: silver cyan, pale violet, moss green, antler ivory, silver grey
casual: Travelling clothes: a silver-grey hooded cloak over a fitted moss-green tunic that laces down the front, with long sleeves, a leather bracer on the left forearm (on the viewer's right when she faces us), slim dark trousers and tall soft boots, and a quiver on her back. She holds the unstrung longbow upright in her left hand, the antler bound to its upper tip.
private: Resting off the road: a loose long-sleeved pale green linen dress to the ankles, a knitted grey wrap and soft shoes, her hair untied and falling down her back. She holds a small knife and a fresh arrow shaft, fletching it with care.
battle: On the ridge, in an old watcher's harness of the Verdant Crown: the silver-grey cloak pinned back, its edge stitched with a faint silver ward thread; over the moss-green tunic a fitted light cuirass of overlapping silver-green enchanted scale, a thin pale rune line glowing along each plate; a single matching scale pauldron; the bracer on the left forearm (on the viewer's right when she faces us) now of rune-etched ward steel with one small lit crystal; the quiver on her back. She draws the longbow to her cheek, the antler bound to its upper tip and an arrow nocked with pale light along its shaft. A calm, exact gaze.
formal: Elven dress for a long table: a long silver-grey gown with fitted sleeves under a pale green overrobe that closes down the front with small antler buttons, and a band of woven green cord across the brow. She stands with her hands folded.
art: A tilted portrait with the bowstring drawn back past her cheek and the antler-tipped bow crossing the frame, her pale violet eyes on the viewer. Cool silver-green dawn light comes from one side and pale gold from the other. Foreground blur: arrow fletchings, drifting leaves and a carved antler tip.
battle_old: On the ridge: the silver-grey cloak pinned back, a light leather jerkin over the moss-green tunic, the bracer on the left forearm (on the viewer's right when she faces us) and the quiver on her back. She draws the longbow to her cheek, the antler bound to its upper tip and an arrow nocked with pale light along its shaft. A calm, exact gaze.
gear: 英雄｜中｜照常（轻甲弓手）｜4档｜她是宴火六人之一，英雄，不看家境。她是翠冠的守望者，要拉长弓，所以穿量身打的轻鳞甲，不上重甲。鹿角长弓和发光的箭不动。

name: 库尔加
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3787
who: Kurga, a half-orc of about thirty-seven, a former chain-slave from the Seventh Pit who carries anything the others cannot lift. Huge, about 210 cm, so broad in the shoulders he turns sideways to pass a door. Grey-green skin, a pair of lower tusks rising from the jaw. Short-cropped glossy black hair with a faint blue sheen, warm amber eyes, heavy brows. Burned into the skin over his left collarbone (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is an old slave brand of tally strokes. Around his right ankle (on the viewer's left when he faces us) he still wears the iron shackle ring he smashed open himself, split and gaping. No earrings, no rings, no jewellery. A slow, quiet, steady air; he barely talks, but counts aloud as he works.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, heavy-jawed half-orc face, NOT a monster: two short lower tusks jutting up from the lower jaw past the upper lip, ordinary otherwise; warm amber eyes under heavy straight brows, a calm, patient gaze; a broad flat nose; grey-green skin with soft darker green shadows.
build: About 210 cm, massive and broad: huge shoulders and back, thick arms and neck, a deep chest, heavy legs.
palette: grey-green skin, rust iron, undyed hemp, dark leather brown, a little dull blue-black
casual: On the road with the troupe: a coarse undyed hemp shirt, the collar torn open so the brand on his left collarbone shows, the sleeves torn off at the shoulder; a worn dark leather vest left unlaced; a rope belt; wide hemp trousers cut off below the knee so the split iron ring on his right ankle shows; rough hide shoes wrapped with cord. A coil of heavy rusted iron chain hangs over his left shoulder. He stands still and patient, one big hand resting on the chain.
private: Resting after a haul: the vest off, a loose long-sleeved undyed hemp shirt, the collar open, the sleeves pushed up, the same cut-off trousers and the split ankle ring, barefoot. He holds a wooden bowl of soup carefully in both big hands, looking down at it with a quiet, almost shy look.
battle: Braced to hold a gate, in heavy war plate kept deliberately plain: over the hemp shirt a thick enchanted leather-and-plate cuirass cut open at the left collar so the slave brand stays bare, a dull blue-white rune line along its seams, no badge or ornament; massive grey enchanted pauldrons riveted on both shoulders; wide rune-etched iron bracers; a leather apron of the pit workers strapped over the trousers, the hide shoes bound tight, the split ring still on his right ankle. A long length of heavy iron chain is slung across both shoulders behind his neck, both fists gripping it; no blade, no club.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced low under a heavy load, the shoulders squared, the knees bent and the feet planted wide, both fists gripping the heavy chain across his shoulders, the mouth closed, the jaw set, counting under his breath; he carries no weapon.
formal: His one clean set for a long table: a clean undyed linen shirt buttoned to the collar, the brand hidden, a long dark green wool coat a size too tight across the back, closing down the front with wooden buttons, fitted sleeves, a plain leather belt, clean dark trousers to the shins showing the split ring on his right ankle, new hide shoes. He stands stiffly upright, the big hands clasped in front, looking uncomfortable and earnest.
art: A low-angle portrait, the camera tilted, his broad face and shoulder filling one side, the amber eyes looking past the viewer, the lips moving as if counting. Hot molten orange light from below and one side, as from a pit of melted stone, cool dark green shadow on the other. Foreground blur: huge links of rusted chain and drifting sparks. He wears the torn hemp shirt and the chain over his shoulder.
battle_old: Braced to hold a gate: a thick patched leather jerkin laced over the hemp shirt, iron plates riveted on both shoulders, wide leather bracers, a leather apron of the pit workers strapped over the trousers, the hide shoes bound tight, the split ring still on his right ankle. A long length of heavy iron chain is slung across both shoulders behind his neck, both fists gripping it; no blade, no club.
gear: 英雄｜贫｜朴素｜4档｜他是宴火六人之一，英雄，出身奴坑，可英雄往上不看家境。他不拿刀不拿棍，只靠锁链和身子，所以照英雄的档用好料子，样子朴素、不加徽记。左锁骨的奴印和右脚踝的断环都露着，铁链不改。

name: 叶尔丹
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3896
who: The weigh-master of the Midspring market, a demon of the long-lived bloodline who has looked sixteen or seventeen since his youth and is nearly two hundred years old: about 168 cm, a slender, narrow-shouldered build, long thin fingers. Pale flaxen hair, short, a little long at the nape. Very pale grey-green eyes. Slightly pointed ears. A small white wax tablet is set into his left collarbone (on the viewer's right when he faces us), always hidden under his buttoned collar. He keeps a small brass balance scale and a brass weight by him. No earrings, no rings, no spectacles. A soft-voiced, patient, polite merchant's air, impossible to read.
palette: pale flax, very pale grey-green, wax white, muted reed green, dull brass
casual: As weigh-master at the marsh market: a long-sleeved undyed linen shirt buttoned to the throat, a muted reed-green wool waistcoat with horn buttons, a plain grey-brown wool coat to the knees closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, dark trousers, worn brown boots, a leather purse on the belt. He holds a small brass balance scale up by its handle in one hand, a brass weight between two fingers of the other, a calm, attentive look, the mouth closed.
private: At home in the back room: a loose long-sleeved linen shirt buttoned to the collar, a thick knitted reed-green cardigan, dark wool trousers, soft felt slippers. He holds an open ledger against his chest with one hand, a pen in the other, a quiet, thoughtful look.
battle: On the road through the reeds, dressed to pass unharmed rather than to fight: a hooded reed-green oilcloth cloak over the buttoned coat, its lining stitched with a faint ward thread that glows dull green-white along the hem and hood edge; a soft dark felt cap pulled down under the hood; beneath the coat a thin salvaged mesh from a sunken tower, glimpsed only at the cuff as a faint silver shimmer; oilcloth gaiters over the boots; a leather satchel slung across the body, a small dim-lit ward charm of old tower glass hanging from its strap. He holds a small brass weight on its cord in one hand; he carries no knife and no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the travelling outfit: standing still and watchful, the hood up, one hand holding the brass weight on its cord close to the chest, the other hand empty at his side, a calm, wary look, the mouth closed; he never fights and holds no weapon.
formal: As a money-changer's apprentice in the eastern upper city: a neat dark slate-blue wool coat closing down the front with small brass buttons to the top of a high collar, fitted sleeves, a white linen shirt collar showing, dark trousers, polished black boots, a soft dark blue felt cap covering his ears, thin white gloves. He holds a closed ledger in front of him with both hands, polite and attentive.
art: A chest-up portrait, the camera tilted, his face turned slightly, looking at the viewer with eyes fully open and the mouth closed, a serious, unreadable expression. Night: cool lamp light from one side, a faint teal glow in his pale grey-green eyes. Foreground blur: the folds of a sheer pale curtain drifting across one corner, and a brass scale pan glinting. He wears the buttoned grey-brown coat and the waistcoat.
battle_old: On the road through the reeds: a hooded reed-green oilcloth cloak over the buttoned coat, a soft dark felt cap pulled down over his ears, oilcloth gaiters over the boots, a leather satchel slung across the body. He holds a small brass weight on its cord in one hand; he carries no knife and no weapon.
gear: 共鸣（估）｜富｜不打仗｜1档｜原页没写位阶，他活了近两百年，靠秤和买卖立身，从不拿刀，按共鸣估。集口作保、换盐换药，家底是富，可他从不出手，拿刀的是他雇的人，所以不穿甲。只照白鸦年间遗迹货的样子，给一件缝了护符线的斗篷、一枚沉塔里出来的护符，暗处还衬一层轻甲网，都是走蛾子路防身的东西，不是打仗的东西。
